name: Zhenye de Jusuo
source:
[url=/c149681]Lam Chotung[/url], the owner of a maid cafe in Shenzhen, found an [url=/c149682]unknown girl[/url] sitting on the ground in front of the shop as she was about to go home. Not only was the girl unconscious, but she was also wearing an unfamiliar maid's outfit. This is how their story begins...

[Edited from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2677040]Steam[/url]]
translation:
[url=/c149681]林祖通[/url]深圳一家女仆咖啡馆的老板发现了一个[url=/c149682]不知名的女孩[/url]她坐在商店门前的地上，准备回家。少女不仅昏迷不醒，而且还穿着陌生的女仆装。他们的故事就这样开始了……
